name: gridlock
description: Gridlock — online multiplayer wall-and-race strategy game for 2 to 6 players

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,mobile -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @gridlock/server" "npm run start -w @gridlock/mobile"
scripts.test: npm run test -w @gridlock/engine && npm run test -w @gridlock/server
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage -w @gridlock/engine && npm run test:coverage -w @gridlock/server
